scope: Machine B V7 target-blind reissue validation only.
failure_reason: V7 assessment adequacy, source-anchor or rationale drift: one source anchor has fewer than four normalized characters.
decision: Do not silently edit any assessment or reassign the group to a reviewer who has already reviewed its source-visible packet. A future reissue requires a fresh target-blind reviewer independent of the retained R001 A lane.
claim_boundary: No reconciliation, final disposition, opaque target join, acceptable set, main-tail designation, retrieval claim, or library claim is materialised.
